description: "Anti-slavery catechism" by Lydia Maria Child is a significant treatise advocating for the abolition of slavery, composed in the early 19th century during a pivotal time in American history. The book is structured as a catechism, presenting questions and answers addressing various aspects and moral implications of slavery.
